name: Goldener Hirsch,  Auberge Collection
positioning: Goldener Hirsch (Auberge Collection) is a Bavarian-inspired inn paired with modern residences, mid-mountain at Deer Valley Resort in Silver Lake Village
best_for: Skiers who want to be steps from the Deer Valley chairlifts
Families and groups wanting one to three-bedroom residences with kitchens

facts.text: The hotel sits mid-mountain in Silver Lake Village at Deer Valley Resort, just steps from the chairlifts.
The property was founded in 1992 by the Eccles family of Utah.
The hotel was inspired by its namesake hotel in St. Moritz, Switzerland.
The hotel offers private ski lockers, a Ski Concierge, ski valet and on-snow storage in Silver Lake Village.
The hotel offers complimentary transportation within a four-mile radius.
The Kitz offers outdoor seating on the veranda or in the adjoining Antler Lounge.
The wine list is anchored by Austrian wines, with selections from Jura, Savoie and Alsace.
The Residences are one to three-bedroom homes with private balconies and chef's kitchens.
The Goldener rooms and suites have original artwork of Austrian landscapes and marble baths with dual vanities and walk-in rain showers.
The residence rental program offers flexible sleeping arrangements, welcome kits for children and babysitting services.

highlights.text: The hotel combines a Bavarian-inspired inn with modern residences designed by architect Tom Kundig.
A steel-and-glass tower with the rooftop pool and hot tub connects to the historic inn by a heated bridge.
The hotel has a heated rooftop pool and an infinity-edge hot tub with views of the Wasatch Mountains, both open to guests year-round.
Guests can book a half- or full-day ski experience with an Olympic ambassador of Deer Valley.
The Hirsch restaurant has a fireside setting with hand-carved wood details, embroidered velvet furnishings and murals of woodland scenes.

considerations.text: Historic Main Street in Park City is about five minutes away by the hotel's complimentary shuttle.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the Deer Valley location.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site amenities due to the boutique size.
